A polish release that finalizes the look and the self-hosting story.

## Changed

- **New UI typeface.** The whole interface is now set in Sansation, self-hosted
  (no runtime call to Google), with the wordmark kept in Bitter.
- **Refreshed hero copy** — a lighter tagline over a single line: "Encrypted ·
  auto-deleted · no tracking · no account · no bullshit", translated across all
  26 languages.
- **Consistent download page** — the brand sits at the top and links home, and
  the share card is crowned with just the logo, matching the main page.
- **Bigger logo** and more breathing room on the home page.
- **Self-hosting docs & template** — a new "Security & Privacy" section in the
  README; the Unraid template pre-fills a `BASE_URL` placeholder and documents
  `APP_LOGO` accepting a URL or a `data:` URI (custom logo with no hosting).

## Fixed

- **Light/dark toggle** no longer needs two clicks for the first switch.
